operations.summary: List tenant scope targets for platform administration
operations.description: Returns a small read-only tenant directory for platform identities. Requires identity.users.manage (or platform.admin) in a platform scope. Billing and other tenant data are intentionally excluded; suspended and closed tenants remain visible with their status.

params.name: search
params.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against tenant name, stable short tenant ID, tenant UUID, and scope UUID.

params.name: parent
params.description: Reseller filter: "none" = platform customers only; a reseller scope UUID (canonical lower case) = its customers; omitted = all.

operations.summary: Put a tenant under a reseller, or back to the platform
operations.description: parent_scope_id null makes the tenant a platform customer again. The parent must be an active reseller, not the tenant itself; a reseller cannot have a parent (one level); a reseller at its customer_limit refuses new customers. Existing subscriptions are kept until they expire. Requires identity.users.manage in the platform scope.
